awq_control: Qwen3-1.7B: higher precision, uniform 4, GPTQ 4, AWQ 4; compare only within this model
budget: all allocation candidates at or below actual uniform-four-bit parameter bytes, including scales/biases; other precision baselines form a tradeoff curve
initialization: same population per seed for all searches, containing uniform four-bit, a one-at-a-time loss-sensitivity allocation, perturbed informed allocations, and random allocations
sensitivity: measure calibration NLL change from lowering each searchable matrix from 4 to 2 bits or raising it to 8; greedily choose bit allocation by predicted additive loss under the exact byte budget; explicitly a local-loss heuristic, not MLX's gradient method
operators: two-point crossover, one elite, mutation probability 1/number of genes; identical repair; Alternis only changes parent selection
selection: evaluate top three search candidates plus uniform four-bit and sensitivity allocation on validation; freeze each seed finalist and the best Alternis allocation before GPTQ combination and any test evaluation
gptq: MLX GPTQ algorithm adapted only for per-module 2/4/8 choices and numerical safety; uniform GPTQ uses the same implementation and calibration
data: search and quantizer calibration mix WikiText-2 training and AG News training; validation uses distinct AG News training records; test uses official AG News test; 400 ARC-Easy test questions exclude all 64 prior questions
runtime_rule: freeze a shared evaluation budget after pilot, before search; prefer 120 evaluations, otherwise 90 or 60 if required by remaining time; log the choice. Three methods use the same budget.
analysis: paired test NLL differences across ten seeds with bootstrap interval; task accuracy uncertainty; report per-run, mean and variability, actual bytes and speed; no test-driven selection or claim of general superiority
comparison_to_v1: changes data, initialization, population, bit choices and budget simultaneously; cannot attribute v1-v2 change to any single improvement
